proposals.title: Implement LCM Two-Tier Proposal and Review Governance Engine
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Two-tier proposal tracking, BC5 review integration, multi-repo staging, granularity controls, and dual-commit sync.

proposals.title: Implement Automated LCM Rule Health Diagnostics and Repair Engine
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Add Test-LCMRuleHealth.ps1 and Repair-LCMRules.ps1 to detect and clean up governance drift, redundant static rule files, and broken junctions across pulled repositories.

proposals.title: Mandate Tripartite Repository Documentation Standard (Architecture, Requirements, Implementation)
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Codify tripartite repo-level documentation distinguishing Architecture (user view), Requirements (technical aspects of design), and Implementation (code representation).

proposals.title: Mandate Universal install/ Directory and Installation.md Lifecycle Runbook Standard
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Codify mandatory install/ directory and Installation.md runbook covering prerequisites, customization, preflight, deployment, health checks, updates, and target folder layout.

proposals.title: Enable Configurable Target Path Parameter in Show-CmdFolderAnalysis.ps1
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Add -Path parameter (with default 'D:\OneDrive\cmd') to tools/Show-CmdFolderAnalysis.ps1, supporting dynamic analysis of arbitrary script directories (e.g. D:\@cmd, D:\OneDrive\cmd\@Repair, staging paths), updating CLI parameter binding, help banner, existence checks, and dynamic HTML report header.

proposals.title: Merge Enter-CmdAdmin UAC Elevation Functionality into GoAdm.cmd
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Merge the robust modern UAC elevation mechanism from Enter-CmdAdmin.cmd into GoAdm.cmd (replacing legacy runas /user:Administrator with PowerShell Start-Process cmd.exe -Verb RunAs and SID S-1-5-32-544 check), unifying CMD elevation under GoAdm and archiving/consolidating Enter-CmdAdmin.cmd.

proposals.title: Add Deduplicated Chat Short-Name View Toggle to Show-Tools (TOOLS_VIEWER)
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Add an interactive toggle switch in Show-ToolIndex.ps1 (TOOLS_VIEWER.html) to switch the Tool Name column into 'Chat Short-Names Only' mode. In this mode, displays clean extension-less chat short names, filters to User-exposed tools, deduplicates across environments (.ps1/.cmd) and repository mirrors, and preserves click-to-run execution.

proposals.title: Modernize BackgroundModifier Architecture via Dynamic Rainmeter Skin Engine
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Revive and redesign BackgroundModifier modernization using a dynamic Rainmeter telemetry skin architecture, resolving previous development bottlenecks: 1) Replace brittle GDI+ bitmap wallpaper baking and cache-busting with live desktop widget overlay, 2) Dynamically generate multi-drive meter configurations from state.json (supporting 13+ drives), 3) Implement lightweight event-driven Rainmeter refresh signaling, 4) Ensure DPI scaling and icon-safe screen positioning.

proposals.title: Implement Export-LCMRules (SaveLCMRules) Governance Exporter and Gemini Sync Tool
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Implement Export-LCMRules.ps1 (with Save-LCMRules and SaveLCMRules aliases) to aggregate all 16 canonical LCM rule policies from .agents/rules/, AGENTS.md, and GEMINI.md into a single structured, clean markdown bundle (with frontmatter stripped and clear section banners), supporting -ToClipboard for 1-click pasting into Gemini Gems and configurable file export targets.

proposals.title: Align LCM Module and Documentation Versioning with Major Baseline Invariant (v6.1.0 / M.Y.Z)
proposals.author: Rolf
proposals.details: Codify and enforce LCM Major Version Alignment Invariant: when a major LCM version M is established, all contained module/spec versions become M.Y.Z (preserving minor/patch evolution). Synchronize all outdated documentation and config references in .github, .copilot, .vscode, .agents/rules, docs, tools, and child repos to LCM v6.1.0.

proposals.title: Establish Major Release Retention Horizon Policy and Standardized History Log Naming Scheme
proposals.author: rgbig
proposals.details: Codify the 2-Major-Release Horizon retention rule for pruning transient logs and deletions upon major release pushes while preserving permanent macro-evolution history logs under a standardized naming taxonomy (##_<Era>-Evolution, Classification: permanent-evolution-history).

proposals.title: Design and Implement LCM Universal Installation Path, Packaging Agent, Preflight Engine, and UX Verification Suite
proposals.author: rgbig
proposals.details: Comprehensive design and implementation of the LCM Installation Path: payload extraction from LCM workspace (excluding subsystems), analogous subsystem install contract, configurable target root directory structure, Setup packaging agent, interactive Pre-Installation Check Tool with unified completion log, separate Onboarding function, and post-installation UX verification tool.

proposals.title: Enhance Pre-Installation Check with Modular Tool Selection & Conditional Deployment Engine
proposals.author: rgbig
proposals.details: Extend Pre-Installation Check Tool and Setup Engine to support modular, user-controlled tool selection (Everything search, AI orchestration variants, Beyond Compare 5, local database backends, REST daemon) with manifest serialization and conditional post-install verification.

proposals.title: Establish Dual-State Proposal Lifecycle (Plan State & Implementation Progress State) and CM Plan Archive
proposals.author: rgbig
proposals.details: Evolve proposal schema to track both Governance Plan State (suggested, approved, deferred, completed) and Implementation Progress State (undecided, queued, in_progress, verification, completed, blocked), and establish dedicated CM archive in Workspace_Inventory/data/proposals/plans/ for all implementation plans and walkthroughs.

proposals.title: Establish Dedicated Installation_LCD Governed Repository for LCM Platform Packaging & Deployment
proposals.author: rgbig
proposals.details: Provision dedicated child repository Installation_LCD under LCM governance (.agents/rules junction, .lcm/config.json baseline 6.1.0, tripartite specs) to isolate packaging agent, preflight checker, modular setup deployer, onboarding engine, and UX verifier outside core LCM until release.
